input-mic.description: A chat-style text input with a mic button: animated waveform driven by real microphone input, and optional live speech-to-text.

button.description: The base button, dark and light variants.

button-sizes.description: Button sizes: Extra Small, Small, Default, Large.

button-spinner.description: Loading buttons with a spinner: Downloading and Uploading.

text-reveal.description: Sequentially fades in text word-by-word with an optional blur effect.

hero-section.description: Hero block with a cursor-reactive grid background and a gradient headline.

hero-section-two.description: Hero block with an animated glowing gradient blob background.

logo-cloud.description: 8-logo grid that drops in row by row, with a heading and subtext.

logo-cloud-two.description: Logo cloud with a heading, subtext, marquee, and a CTA button.

mouse-follow.description: Four cursor-following effects: direct, spring, velocity-stretch blob, and magnetic pull. Simple/Spring adapted from Skiper UI, credit required.

text-scroll.description: Scroll-driven text and icon animation (3 variants) with Lenis smooth scroll. Adapted from Skiper UI, credit required.

voice-beam.description: Wraps a child element and overlays a sound-reactive glow along its bottom edge: a centered, colorful beam that rises and blooms with the voice. Auto-detects the child's border radius, ships zero runtime dependencies and needs React 18 or newer.
